<!DOCTYPE html>

<html class="light" lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>FPT ExamHub - Onboarding</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@100..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script id="tailwind-config">
      tailwind.config = {
        darkMode: "class",
        theme: {
          extend: {
            "colors": {
                    "surface-tint": "#ac3400",
                    "tertiary-fixed": "#c7e7ff",
                    "tertiary": "#286182",
                    "secondary-fixed-dim": "#b0c7f1",
                    "on-surface-variant": "#5a4139",
                    "primary-fixed": "#ffdbd0",
                    "on-tertiary-fixed": "#001e2e",
                    "on-tertiary": "#ffffff",
                    "inverse-primary": "#ffb59d",
                    "on-secondary": "#ffffff",
                    "background": "#ffffff",
                    "primary-container": "#d14307",
                    "secondary-fixed": "#d5e3ff",
                    "on-primary-container": "#fffbff",
                    "outline": "#8e7067",
                    "primary": "#F15A22",
                    "surface-bright": "#f8f9ff",
                    "on-tertiary-container": "#fcfcff",
                    "on-secondary-fixed": "#001b3c",
                    "on-secondary-fixed-variant": "#30476a",
                    "inverse-on-surface": "#eaf1ff",
                    "on-background": "#0b1c30",
                    "surface-dim": "#cbdbf5",
                    "on-secondary-container": "#445a7f",
                    "on-error": "#ffffff",
                    "on-tertiary-fixed-variant": "#064c6b",
                    "inverse-surface": "#213145",
                    "on-surface": "#0b1c30",
                    "tertiary-fixed-dim": "#98cdf2",
                    "error": "#ba1a1a",
                    "on-error-container": "#93000a",
                    "secondary-container": "#bbd3fd",
                    "surface-container": "#e5eeff",
                    "tertiary-container": "#447a9c",
                    "surface": "#f8f9ff",
                    "surface-container-lowest": "#ffffff",
                    "on-primary-fixed-variant": "#842600",
                    "outline-variant": "#e2bfb4",
                    "error-container": "#ffdad6",
                    "on-primary-fixed": "#390b00",
                    "secondary": "#485f84",
                    "primary-fixed-dim": "#ffb59d",
                    "on-primary": "#ffffff",
                    "surface-variant": "#d3e4fe"
            },
            "borderRadius": {
                    "DEFAULT": "0.25rem",
                    "lg": "0.5rem",
                    "xl": "0.75rem",
                    "full": "9999px"
            },
            "spacing": {
                    "gutter": "12px",
                    "sm": "12px",
                    "container-padding": "16px",
                    "lg": "24px",
                    "base": "4px",
                    "md": "16px",
                    "xl": "32px",
                    "xs": "8px"
            },
            "fontFamily": {
                    "title-lg": ["Inter"],
                    "headline-sm": ["Inter"],
                    "display-lg-mobile": ["Inter"],
                    "label-md": ["Inter"],
                    "body-md": ["Inter"],
                    "body-lg": ["Inter"],
                    "headline-md": ["Inter"],
                    "display-lg": ["Inter"]
            },
            "fontSize": {
                    "title-lg": ["18px", {"lineHeight": "26px", "fontWeight": "600"}],
                    "headline-sm": ["20px", {"lineHeight": "28px", "fontWeight": "600"}],
                    "display-lg-mobile": ["28px", {"lineHeight": "36px", "fontWeight": "700"}],
                    "label-md": ["12px", {"lineHeight": "16px", "letterSpacing": "0.05em", "fontWeight": "500"}],
                    "body-md": ["14px", {"lineHeight": "20px", "fontWeight": "400"}],
                    "body-lg": ["16px", {"lineHeight": "24px", "fontWeight": "400"}],
                    "headline-md": ["24px", {"lineHeight": "32px", "letterSpacing": "-0.01em", "fontWeight": "600"}],
                    "display-lg": ["32px", {"lineHeight": "40px", "letterSpacing": "-0.02em", "fontWeight": "700"}]
            }
          }
        }
      }
    </script>
<style>
        @keyframes float {
            0% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-20px) translateX(10px); }
            100% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px); }
        }
        .decorative-circle {
            animation: float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .decorative-dot {
            animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
        }
        .wave-shape {
            clip-path: polygon(0 15%, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
        }
        .ios-status-bar { height: 44px; }
        .ios-home-indicator { height: 34px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-background font-body-md text-on-background overflow-hidden select-none">
<!-- Screen Wrapper (iPhone 14 Pro aspect ratio simulation) -->
<main class="relative h-screen w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-between">
<!-- Decorative Background Layer -->
<div class="absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden">
<div class="decorative-circle absolute top-[10%] -left-10 w-32 h-32 rounded-full bg-primary opacity-[0.15]"></div>
<div class="decorative-dot absolute top-[25%] right-10 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-primary opacity-[0.15]"></div>
<div class="decorative-circle absolute top-[50%] right-[-40px] w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-primary opacity-[0.15]"></div>
<div class="decorative-dot absolute bottom-[40%] left-20 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-primary opacity-[0.15]"></div>
</div>
<!-- Top Area: Logo -->
<header class="w-full px-md pt-gutter z-10">
<div class="ios-status-bar"></div>
<img alt="FPT University Crest" class="w-8 h-8 object-contain" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
</header>
<!-- Center Area: Branding -->
<section class="flex flex-col items-center text-center px-container-padding z-10 mt-xl">
<div class="mb-lg transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-110">
<img alt="Graduation Cap Icon" class="w-16 h-16 object-contain" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
</div>
<h1 class="font-display-lg-mobile text-display-lg-mobile text-primary mb-xs tracking-tight">
                ExamHub
            </h1>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-[#6B7280]">
                Smart Learning, Smart Testing
            </p>
</section>
<!-- Spacer -->
<div class="flex-grow"></div>
<!-- Bottom Area: Actions & Wave -->
<footer class="w-full relative z-10">
<!-- Wave Shape Background -->
<div class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-[35vh] bg-primary wave-shape z-0"></div>
<!-- Buttons Content -->
<div class="relative z-20 px-container-padding pb-xl">
<div class="flex flex-col gap-sm">
<!-- Get Started Button -->
<button class="w-full h-[52px] bg-primary text-white font-title-lg text-[15px] rounded-[12px] shadow-lg active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-primary">
                        Get Started
                    </button>
<!-- Sign In Button -->
<button class="w-full h-[52px] bg-white text-primary font-title-lg text-[15px] rounded-[12px] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-primary">
                        Sign In
                    </button>
</div>
<!-- iPhone Home Indicator Padding -->
<div class="ios-home-indicator"></div>
</div>
</footer>
</main>
<!-- Micro-interaction Script -->
<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Subtle entrance animations
            const elements = document.querySelectorAll('header, section, footer');
            elements.forEach((el, index) => {
                el.style.opacity = '0';
                el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
                el.style.transition = `all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) ${index * 0.15}s`;
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    el.style.opacity = '1';
                    el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, 100);
            });

            // Button active states (touch)
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button');
            buttons.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', () => btn.classList.add('opacity-80'));
                btn.addEventListener('touchend', () => btn.classList.remove('opacity-80'));
            });
        });
    </script>
</body></html>
